ex.en: I believe the medium size will fit you better.
ex.zh: 我想中號會比較適合您。

ex.en: These jeans don't fit me anymore.
ex.zh: 這條牛仔褲我已經穿不下了。

ex.en: I don't think she is fit for the job.
ex.zh: 我不覺得她適合這份工作。

ex.en: The water isn't fit to drink.
ex.zh: 這水不能喝。

ex.en: She runs every day to stay fit.
ex.zh: 她每天跑步保持健康。

ex.en: You look really fit these days.
ex.zh: 你最近看起來身材很好。

ex.en: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
ex.zh: 減稅常被當作刺激經濟的主要財政工具。

ex.en: The government announced a new fiscal policy.
ex.zh: 政府宣布了新的財政政策。

ex.en: Our fiscal year begins in April.
ex.zh: 我們的會計年度從四月開始。

ex.en: Sales rose sharply in the last fiscal year.
ex.zh: 上個會計年度的銷售額大幅成長。

ex.en: Doctor, please give this child first aid.
ex.zh: 醫生，請給這孩子急救。

ex.en: Everyone should learn basic first aid.
ex.zh: 每個人都應該學基本的急救。

ex.en: The sales figures for March were disappointing.
ex.zh: 三月的銷售數字令人失望。

ex.en: Can you check these figures again?
ex.zh: 可以再核對一次這些數字嗎？

ex.en: Bill is still a legendary figure in this company.
ex.zh: 比爾在這家公司仍是傳奇人物。

ex.en: Prominent figures in the literary world gathered together last night.
ex.zh: 文學界的知名人士昨晚齊聚一堂。

ex.en: I cannot figure out why he has done that.
ex.zh: 我不明白他為什麼要做那種事。

ex.en: I'll let you know when I've figured it out.
ex.zh: 我搞明白了會告訴你。

ex.en: I forgot to save the file before switching off.
ex.zh: 我關機前忘了存檔。

ex.en: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
ex.zh: 你知道怎麼恢復已刪除的檔案嗎？

ex.en: I need to have a quick look at the files.
ex.zh: 我需要很快看一下這些檔案。

ex.en: Tom has already filed a complaint.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經提出了申訴。

ex.en: She filed a complaint with the manager.
ex.zh: 她向經理提出了申訴。

ex.en: Mary is filing her nails.
ex.zh: 瑪麗在磨指甲。

ex.en: He filed the edges of the metal until they were smooth.
ex.zh: 他把金屬邊緣磨到光滑。
